selected.script: [nonchalant] Three signs your friend has already spent money they haven't made. One: you say, let's sell a few things. They hear, Bugatti. [amused] Two: they find the recliner before they find anything to list. Three: you're explaining the work, and they're already dreaming. [warmly] Tag your big-dreaming friend. Share this with the one who keeps them grounded.

[nonchalant] Three signs your garage has become a storage unit. One: the car hasn't been inside in months. Two: I'll sort it this weekend has become a family tradition. [amused] Three: opening the door needs a warning. [warmly] Start with one box. Tag the person this reminds you of, and share it before next weekend.

[nonchalant] Every group has these three people. One: the person trying to help. Two: the person who hears a plan and immediately starts dreaming. [amused] Three: the one who shows up just to roast everybody. [curious] Be honest. Which one are you? [warmly] Tag your group, and share this with the friend who gets the last word.

[nonchalant] Three signs a quick favor has become a whole episode. One: you came over for one job. Two: a neighbor pulls up with another question. [amused] Three: somehow, you're explaining what's on somebody's forehead. You can't plan these conversations. [warmly] Tag the friend whose quick favor is never quick, and share this with your group.
